name: Kővágótöttös (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kővágótöttös: a red shield with a yellow bunch of grapes and vine leaves, above a scroll inscribed Kővágótöttös.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
